Ch133 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 133)

Subject: homological algebra | ID: 25936

Result

Let Omega be a bounded domain with smooth boundary. Every convex solution of the elliptic equation in Omega extends smoothly to the closure.

Proof

Step 1. By the Fredholm spectral theorem, we decompose \(Q_{01330011} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the Fredholm spectral family.

Step 2. The affine operator \(P_{01330012}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle P_{01330012} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 3. By the monotone spectral theorem, we decompose \(P_{01330013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the monotone spectral family.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via nonlinear interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via iterative interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01330021 \cdot C_01330022 \cdot C_01330023\).
